{"Author":"dajoey","Name":"Gluttony Combo","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"1.0.4.315","CategoryTags":null,"Changelog":"v1.0.4.317 (2026-10-21) [testing]
- **The Cast-Start Stillness setting is removed, together with the v1.0.4.316 testing build it shipped in.** That build held a fresh cast bar for a moment after movement stopped to keep the bar from being glued onto a dodge, but casting into a stop is normal cast mechanics, not a stuck slide-cast, so the hold answered a problem the game does not have. Cast-start movement behaviour is again exactly the v1.0.4.315 behaviour: moving always blocks a new cast start, instant casts and orbwalker-driven movement never block, and a stopped player casts immediately. The v1.0.4.315 FATE-grind spike skip is untouched. A settings file that still carries the old key loads unchanged; the key is ignored and disappears at the next save.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Supersedes the v1.0.4.316 testing build, which is withdrawn. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.315 (2026-10-20) [testing]
- **The FATE-grind spike skip now stays on.** The first testing build of the part-of-pack spike skip (v1.0.4.314) checked for spiked mobs through its own skip list: with a skip armed, the next check saw the spiked mobs already hidden, believed none were left and switched the skip off, so the spiked mob could be targeted again on alternating ticks. The check now reads the full pack every tick, the skip stays armed while a spiked mob lives, and a pack that decays to only spiked mobs takes the full stop as before.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Supersedes the v1.0.4.314 testing build. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.314 (2026-10-20) [testing]
- **The enemy-reflect stop no longer freezes a FATE grind over spikes on part of the pack.** While another plugin drives the rotation with FATE priority inside a FATE, a mob carrying a reflect or counter-stance status (Ice Spikes, Shock Spikes, Blaze Spikes, the Counter stances) no longer stops every press for the status's full duration: the rotation attacks the rest of the pack first and leaves the carrier alone. The full stop keeps everything it covered before - manual play, foray territories (Eureka's charged spikes kill), and a pack where every target reflects - and still targets the player and cancels casts there. Every job the grind drives had the same stall, not only Summoner.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.313 (2026-10-20) [testing]
- **Ninja: merged the upstream ninjutsu rework (WrathCombo 95211afb8).** The mudra casts (Fuma Shuriken, Raiton, Katon, Suiton, Huton, Doton, Hyosho Ranryu, Goka Mekkyaku) now track the mudra already pressed as flags and finish the jutsu from that record, replacing the last-action switch; the standalone Fuma Shuriken readiness check is removed, so Fuma is offered whenever the higher jutsu is not yet learned; Hyosho Ranryu and Goka Mekkyaku no longer require Ten to be ready on top of Kassatsu.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.312 (2026-10-19) [testing]
- **White Mage and Astrologian: the timed raidwide AoE regen (Medica II/Medica III, Aspected Helios/Helios Conjunction) now casts once per raidwide.** The scheduled cast that follows the raidwide's damage burst is the only one: while that cast is timed up, the earlier auto-detection no longer fires the same heal as well, and a cast that landed before the burst is not followed by the same regen again while its heal-over-time is still active. After the regen expires, the heal is available as before. Scholar and Sage raidwide shields are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.311 (2026-10-18) [testing]
- **Deep Dungeon (Palace of the Dead): the sustaining potion is spent inside a behemoth's Ecliptic Meteor window whatever the health slider says.** The floor-180 meteor takes roughly 80% of maximum health, so a potion held back for after the hit is wasted. The gate now treats the meteor window itself as a heal window and rolls the potion in it; the preset toggle, item readiness and the no-Rehabilitation check all still apply, and the health slider keeps ruling everywhere else. A behemoth tracker recognises the two floor-180 behemoths by name and watches the boss's cast and health for the meteor threshold, exposing a hold band (while the cast nears the threshold) and the window (the cast itself) to the job modules below.
- **Ninja: Shade Shift is banked for the Ecliptic Meteor and pressed in the window.** While the behemoth nears its meteor threshold the shield is no longer spent on its own health or incoming-damage triggers; in the window itself it presses even at full health.
- **Summoner: Radiant Aegis banks and presses around the Ecliptic Meteor.** The overcap rule holds the second charge while the behemoth nears the threshold instead of burning it early; the maintain rule keeps a shield up through the window even above its health slider.
- **Black Mage: Manaward is banked for the Ecliptic Meteor in solo play.** The own-health trigger is held while the behemoth nears the threshold; the incoming-damage trigger still presses the ward for the cast itself, so the window stays covered.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.","DalamudApiLevel":15,"Description":"Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
